{{Quote|You might even catch a glimpse of the recently elected Queen of Naboo.|Star Tours commercial|<ref name="ST:AC" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]] was appointed the new '''Queen of Naboo'''<ref name="ST:AC" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="ST2 date">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> Her recent election was mentioned in a commercial released by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency to advertise its trips to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] advertisement contained footage of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] officials parading toward the steps of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]], where the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] stood with other dignitaries. That ceremonial march in honor of the new Queen was very reminiscent<ref name="ST:AC" /> of [[Freedom of Naboo/Legends|the one]] that followed the victory of the united [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Nabooian Humans]] and Gungans against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The election of a Nabooian monarch is qualified as "recent" in a [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B8lCSP8pMnQ fake advertisement] shown in the queue of the ride simulator attraction ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''. The commercial reuses footage of the triumph parade featured at the end of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. However, the selected images either show the characters from a distance or with their back turned so they cannot be identified as the protagonists of ''The Phantom Menace''.<ref name="ST:AC" />

According to the [[StarWars.com]] article "[[Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours]]," the events of ''Star Tours: The Adventures Continue'' occurred in 1 BBY.<ref name="ST2 date" /> However, the defunct ''[[Star Wars]]''-themed [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' had already established Queen [[Kylantha]] as the reigning monarch in that time period.<ref name="gal">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
